title: Twist E25: Applicable homogeneous signature baseline with complete output certificates
status_note: Partial local evidence, 2026-10-23; full experiment blocked and unfunded. 24 affine F4 workloads have complete independent certificates in each applicable arm; full homogeneous checks pass 21 and leave three incomplete. Signature backend fails every cell and its positive control. No timing or signature improvement admitted. Raw publication is verified in setec-astronomy-artifacts (2026-10-25): fresh download, all member hashes and frozen incidence CAS replay pass. The earlier denials targeted the wrong bucket.
blocked_on: note:24 affine F4 workloads have complete independent certificates in each applicable arm; full homogeneous checks pass 21 and leave three incomplete. Signature backend fails every cell and its positive control. No timing or signature improvement admitted.
question: Can a same-characteristic signature solver be compared fairly after homogenization, saturation and dehomogenization are fully verified and priced?
decision_value: Only verified equal tasks admit a stage comparison. If no applicable signature implementation is available, that baseline remains missing rather than being replaced by a wrong-characteristic run.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB, 30 seconds per engine/system with the same hard envelope for each compared engine. Freeze timeout semantics and record extraction/checking separately before extending the grid. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.

outputs.result_schema: Partial local twist.followup-run/v1 evidence exists; original full acceptance criteria remain unmet. See execution-v2 and the follow-up report.
